svg.text: the CI a generated project ships is valid and really
Scenario: a real runner runs the generated pipeline and its first job passes

g.text: Given a runner scoped to a freshly generated project comes online
A runner is the machine that actually runs pipeline jobs. The embedded GitLab has none, so
this story starts one that serves only this project, then points GitLab at it. Because it is
scoped to one project, it never steals jobs from other tests.
Then the pipeline's first job runs on that runner and passes
The runner pulls the generated pipeline in and runs it. We watch the pipeline's first job,
plan, which runs the plan phase. When it turns green, a real runner has pulled the toolbox
base image and run a real job of the generated CI to success.
